messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Set the standoff height equal to twice the across-flats size; the bore and hex profile stay the same.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

response:
```json
{
  "match": true,
  "confidence": 0.9,
  "reason": "The edited part shows a significantly increased height relative to its width, consistent with doubling the height to match twice the across-flats dimension, while the top view confirms the hexagonal profile and bore size remain unchanged."
}
```
